course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice describing imagined outcomes with det skulle bli or det skulle vara.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Talking about whether a possible event, plan, or change would feel good or difficult.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Evaluating possible outcomes in a natural conversation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss how a possible weekend event or workday change would turn out.

main_focus.name: imagined outcomes with skulle bli and skulle vara
main_focus.description: Use skulle bli or skulle vara to describe how a possible situation would feel or turn out.
model_examples: Det skulle bli roligt om fler följde med.
Det skulle vara skönt med en lugn kväll.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use skulle bli or skulle vara naturally 2-3 times.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use feeling and outcome words in a concrete planning context.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions a possible plan or change.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss how the outcome would feel under one simple condition.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether the possible outcome sounds positive enough.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat outcome language in slightly different forms

focus: the possible plan or change being evaluated
the imagined outcome and feeling attached to it
whether the option is accepted or avoided and why

sentence_focus: one sentence with det skulle bli
one sentence with det skulle vara
one sentence with a simple om condition
one sentence describing a stressful or calm outcome
one sentence deciding based on the imagined result
